Title: Public preview: Virtual machine serial console

Body.Content:
Virtual machine serial console is now public preview. This feature allows bidirectional serial console access to your virtual machines. The preview is available in global Azure regions.

To try it, look for Serial console (Preview) in the Support+Troubleshooting section of your virtual machine. For more information, see Serial console help.
